## How it was tested

- [ ] `ruff format . && ruff check . && pytest` pass
- [ ] Tried in the app (`--demo` or a real session) if the UI changed
- [ ] Added a record in `docs/decisions/` if this changes a design trade-off
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal data or local paths added (code, tests, screenshots, logs)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased" if users will notice the change
